summary.text: Use the Self-employment dashboard with Singpass to check your MediSave payable. If you do not have Singpass, apply for it online.

steps.name: Get Singpass
steps.text: If you do not have Singpass, apply for it online.

steps.name: Check MediSave
steps.text: Log in to the Self-employment dashboard using your Singpass to check your MediSave payable.

example_phrasings: How can I check whether I have any MediSave payable as a self-employed person?
How do I check my MediSave payable?
Where can I see what I need to pay into MediSave?

sources.page_title: How can I check whether I have any MediSave payable as a self-employed person?

quotes.text: You can check your MediSave payable by logging in to the Self-employment dashboard using your Singpass.
You can apply for your Singpass online if you do not have one.
